referenceNotes: Total deployed trap limit equals total held capacity.
Trigger and effect radii differ: 1.35 and 1.7.
A full mine inventory blocks S1 SP recovery.
webMappingLimits: Logical placement is immediate; the original OnStart event arms the mine and OnAttack samples effect recipients. Compiled Unity birth/event scheduling is unverified.
The shared influence marker is one non-additive instance with maximum remaining lifetime and incoming modifiers. Native mixed-skill overlap priority is unverified.
Trap stock includes the ready card and stacked cards. Paid placement starts its cooldown; recharge does not reset it.
The selected public owner controller supplies attacks, Bullseye, all three source skills and an independent source-fed mine deck. Modules and native particles/audio are not supported.
Owner phases use whole source entrance/transition clips, uncapped local attack-clip scaling and an interval/loop completion gate. Numeric native FSM and same-frame callback ordering are unverified.

Ordinary/S2 critical and ATK values are sampled at impact, before the shared dodge/damage pipeline; S3 captures ATK and critical at projectile birth. Native critical/dodge ordering and transferred-source damage behavior are not certified.

S2 captures the trace point and samples its source-radius splash at the projectile's 0.1-second stop boundary; huge-unit body overlap uses the shared engine geometry. S3 keeps core blocker priority, then prefers any influence marker. Native selector ordering is unverified.

The local owner-finish output starts at departure and samples recipients at the source projectile stop: about 0.9 seconds for death and 0.1 seconds for withdrawal. Movement delay is inside its lifetime. Buff-ability transport into that output and native event/FSM callback ordering are unverified.
